name: Electroshock Coil
body:
School transmutation (electricity); Level machinesmith 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a coil of copper wire)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one metallic melee weapon touched
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell attaches a charged wrapping of wire to the base of the blade or the metal headpiece of the weapon, sending a powerful current of electricity through it. The weapon now deals an additional 3d6 electricity damage that does not stack with the shock weapon property. Also, whenever the weapon confirms a critical hit, the target must now succeed on a Reflex save or be stunned for 2d4 rounds.
